pages.text: A $(item)Parking Meter$() charges the car parked beside it (within 3 blocks). Right-click it, choose 10 to 120 minutes, and pay by card or cash to its owner.$(br2)Overstay and, after a minute's grace, the car's owner gets a $(4)parking ticket$(), and another every 15 minutes.
The owner's cars park free. The $(l)Settings$() tab sets the rate and the fine. A car left at an expired meter can be towed to an $(l:business/impound)impound lot$(/l).
